summary: TEXT and DM history lists share tested reply-target navigation: scroll a target already in the loaded DOM, otherwise request the bounded context view.

checks.name: Test-first reply navigation regression
checks.observation: Before implementation the test suite failed because the navigation helper did not exist. After implementation all 3 cases passed: loaded target scrolling, missing target fallback, and fallback while the history list is unmounted.

checks.name: Full frontend test suite
checks.observation: All 234 test files and 713 tests passed.

checks.name: Frontend production build
checks.observation: TypeScript/Vue type-check and Vite production build passed. Vite emitted its existing advisory about bundles larger than 500 kB.

limitations: Tests exercise the shared navigation decision without a real browser layout or scroll viewport.
Live backend context loading and read-cursor behavior remain unverified.
remaining: Verify actual scroll positioning and bounded context/return interaction in a browser session with history spanning multiple pages.
